description: This 4TU.ResearchData collection provides soil and climate inputs for crop modelling in North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany. Spatial grids at one, ten, 25, 50 and 100 kilometres aggregate climate inputs from approximately one-kilometre and soil inputs from approximately 300-metre source data. CSV files are freely reusable under CC BY 4.0. The depositing research team designed the collection to test how input aggregation affects crop-model outputs under different production and management assumptions. The inspected metadata does not establish the complete temporal period. Coarser grids remove local variation, so differences across resolutions should not be interpreted as independent observations. No directly related catalogue resource was identified.
name: Climate and soil input data aggregation effects in crop models
